annotations.title: Prepare micro-entity accounts to file in the browser

description: Works out the micro-entity accounts from the open DIYA-GL book, as derive_micro_entity_accounts does, and answers a link to the micro-entity accounts form on DIY Accounting Submit with the period, both years' balance sheets, the employee count and the director filled in. The person opens the link, looks up the company, checks the figures, adds the date approved and the statements, and files there with the company's authentication code. Use this when the person asks to file their micro-entity accounts at Companies House. It never files anything and contacts no outside service: the figures filed are the ones the person sees on the page.
name: prepare_micro_entity_accounts
title: Prepare micro-entity accounts to file in the browser
